title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.37
summary: A simpler Options sidebar and clearer title menus.

sections.heading: Ratings in Appearance
bullets: Find Rating sources and Rating order together under Appearance. Your existing rating choices stay saved.

sections.heading: Relevant tracking controls
bullets: Watch tracking settings appear for movies, shows, seasons and episodes. The global control remains under Playback & sync.

sections.heading: Keep your complete setup
bullets: Update BlackLanturn keeps accounts, playback settings, sources, watched progress, row arrangements and unrelated add-ons. Both branded icon packs and current compatibility patches remain included.
